name: Openai
notes: not_member (erik): Erik's ruling, 2026-09-16: 'If OpenAI did not receive investment from a YC entity, keep out.' Verified: at its December 2015 founding OpenAI was a non-profit funded by contributions from Altman, Brockman, Musk, Livingston, Thiel, AWS, Infosys and YC Research (TechCrunch, 2015-12-11: 'The organization is being funded by ... and YC Research'; 'Those funders have contributed $1 billion'). YC Research was a non-profit research lab that Sam Altman jump-started with $10M of his own money, which YC's own post said was 'not ... with the goal of helping YC's startups succeed or adding to our bottom line'; it is none of YC's 20 address-verified fund vehicles and none of the 19 funds in YC Management's ADV. A donation by a separately funded non-profit lab to a non-profit is not an investment by a YC entity, and no YC fund appears in any later OpenAI financing (Microsoft 2019 and 2023; the Oct 2024 round; the 2025 SoftBank-led round with Thrive, Coatue and Altimeter). YC's archived company page for OpenAI therefore reflects affiliation, not fund money, and does not carry membership. Supersedes the run's agent verdict of 2026-09-07.

name: imeem inc
notes: not_member (agent-membership-pass): In 2009 Dalton Caldwell was imeem's own founder-CEO, with Sequoia's Mark Kvamme and Morgenthaler's Ken Gullicksen on the board; he did not join YC as a partner until 2013.

name: PAPERG INC
notes: not_member (agent-membership-pass): Tyler Bosmeny is listed only as an Executive Officer of PaperG, the Yale-founded ad-tech company where he was VP of Sales in 2009-2012 (directors from Launch Capital); he founded Clever (YC S12) afterwards and became a YC partner only in 2023.

name: Alphonso Labs Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-membership-pass): Alphonso Labs is Pulse News, Ankit Gupta's OWN Stanford-born company (he signs as co-founder/officer beside Akshay Kothari, with NEA's Patrick Chung as the 2011 director) and this is a different person from YC's partner Ankit Gupta, the Reverie Labs (W18) founder.

name: NVISION MEDICAL Corp
notes: not_member (agent-membership-pass): Across 2012-2016 Surbhi Sarna was nVision Medical's own founder-CEO, with Catalyst Health Ventures, LMNVC and EXXclaim directors on the filings and Boston Scientific buying the company in 2018; she joined YC as a visiting partner in 2020 and group partner in Nov 2021.

name: Esper Technologies, Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-membership-pass): At the 2016-03 filing Garry Tan was managing partner of Initialized Capital (YC partner 2011-2015, YC CEO only from Jan 2023), and his director seat at Andrew Lee's Esper scheduling-assistant startup came with Initialized's seed alongside 8VC and Khosla; no YC fund and no YC batch entry.

name: Privacy Labs, Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-membership-pass): The 2017-02 round was a $4M seed led by Initialized Capital, and the coverage states explicitly that Initialized managing partner Garry Tan joined the board as a result, so the seat is Initialized's and not YC's.

name: Bicycle Health Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-membership-pass): The same Pulse/LinkedIn Ankit Gupta founded Bicycle Health and signs all three filings as its CEO, with Questa Capital's Ryan Drant on the board; his firm at filing time is Bicycle Health itself, and YC's roster Ankit Gupta (Reverie Labs W18, Ginkgo) is a different person.

name: Formic Technologies, Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-membership-pass): Initialized Capital's own write-up says Garry Tan led Formic's seed while at Initialized (2021-03 filing), founder Saman Farid came from Baidu Ventures rather than a batch, and Formic appears nowhere in YC's company directory.

name: Quizizz Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-membership-pass): This is a third, Bangalore-based Ankit Gupta who co-founded Quizizz with Deepak Cheenath; the 2021-02 filing is their $12.5M Series A led by Eight Roads with Nexus and Prime Venture Partners (director Shripati Acharya), with no YC fund and no batch listing.

name: Trunk Technologies, Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-membership-pass): Trunk.io's $25M Series A of 2022-03 was led by Initialized Capital (Garry Tan) with a16z, ten months before Tan returned to YC as CEO, and Trunk is not a YC batch company.

name: CellarTracker! LLC
notes: not_member (agent-membership-pass): Eric LeVine signs both filings as founder-CEO of his own Seattle wine-cellar company, which he built after leaving Microsoft in 2004; YC's roster Eric Levine is the Berbix (S18) co-founder and Clawvisor founder, a different person, and no YC fund is on the round.

name: DigniFi Holding, Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-membership-pass): A director-only seat on a $1,250 nominal filing by an Arizona auto-repair lender run by Neeraj Mehta, alongside auto and fintech operators; nothing ties it to YC's Eric Levine (Berbix S18, ex-Airbnb) and no YC fund appears, so it is the personal-seat class.
